attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Idaho military retirement exemption (2025). Conditional full exemption: fully exempt if disabled veteran OR age 62+, otherwise fully taxable. Honors MSRRA and SCRA. Source: MOAA State Report Card, ID State Tax Commission.

condition_details.condition_comment: Disabled veteran OR age 62+; is_disabled OR age >= 62
condition_details.condition_dsl: Disabled veteran OR age 62+; is_disabled OR age >= 62

action_details.action_comment: No ID military retirement exemption (not disabled, age < 62)
action_details.action_dsl: No ID military retirement exemption (not disabled, age < 62)

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates Idaho state income tax per Form 40. Idaho uses a two-tier system: 0% on first $4,811 (single) or $9,622 (married), then 5.3% on income above threshold. Includes food tax credit of $155 per person.

initial_action.action_postfix: "IDAHO FORM 40 - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 local@ num_people > result.agi /result.id_agi xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Married filing status; Married filing jointly or separately

condition_details.condition_postfix: job.taxpayers arraysize job.dependents arraysize + local@ num_people > num_people 1 >=

action_details.action_comment: Calculate ID tax for married filers; Calculate Idaho tax with married threshold ($9,622)
action_details.action_postfix: " Starting Federal AGI: $" result.agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.agi local@ id_retirement_subtraction > 0 local@ state_bond_addition > { dup type income_type > income_type "pension" streq income_type "ira_distribution" streq or income_type "social_security" streq or if dup gross_amount id_retirement_subtraction f+ local@ id_retirement_subtraction > endif } job.incomes forall id_retirement_subtraction 0 f> if " Subtract Retirement Income: -$" id_retirement_subtraction cvs strconcat " (ID allows retirement subtraction)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.id_agi id_retirement_subtraction f- /result.id_agi xdef endif " Idaho AGI: $" result.id_agi cvs strconcat " (Form 40 Line 24)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.id_agi id_standard_deduction_married f- 0 fmax /result.id_taxable_income xdef " Idaho Taxable Income: $" result.id_taxable_income cvs strconcat " (AGI - Standard Deduction $" strconcat id_standard_deduction_married cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.id_taxable_income id_bracket_threshold_married fmin /result.id_bracket_1_income xdef result.id_taxable_income id_bracket_threshold_married f- 0 fmax /result.id_bracket_2_income xdef " Tax Brackets:" job.audit_trail swap addto " 0% bracket (first $" id_bracket_threshold_married cvs strconcat "): $" strconcat result.id_bracket_1_income cvs strconcat " × 0% = $0" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " 5.3% bracket (above $" id_bracket_threshold_married cvs strconcat "): $" strconcat result.id_bracket_2_income cvs strconcat " × 5.3% = $" strconcat result.id_bracket_2_income id_tax_rate f* cvs strconcat strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.id_bracket_2_income id_tax_rate f* /result.id_tax_before_credits xdef " Idaho Tax Before Credits: $" result.id_tax_before_credits cvs strconcat " (Form 40 Line 40)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto num_people id_food_tax_credit f* /result.id_food_tax_credit_total xdef " Food Tax Credit: " num_people cvs strconcat " × $" strconcat id_food_tax_credit cvs strconcat " = $" strconcat result.id_food_tax_credit_total cvs strconcat strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.id_tax_before_credits result.id_food_tax_credit_total f- 0 fmax /result.id_tax xdef " Idaho Tax (after credits): $" result.id_tax cvs strconcat " (Form 40 Line 44)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
